rules.selection: All pre-extension profile records; actual frozen parent-to-proposed-candidate endpoints, feature boxes and binary64 score caps are unchanged
rules.extension: Exact signed affine feature-box extrema with independently checked per-output attaining corners
rules.comparison: Existing identity-chain triangle envelope and signed interval on identical endpoints and boxes; no relaxation solver or candidate refitting
rules.timing: One unique-pair run in fixed triangle-generator, signed-generator, signed-checker order; tracemalloc enabled for each timed operation; Python allocation peak, not process/kernel RSS
rules.duplicate_accounting: Preserve every assigned step and controller/order; repeated endpoint/domain pairs share certificates and timing
rules.evaluation: Frozen proposed candidate versus its actual parent; no revised sequence deployment or new admission policy
rules.heldout: Novel official-test feature rows primary, complete official test secondary; reused earlier-study rows, not independent population confirmation
rules.feature_domain: Unchanged protected-calibration coordinate box including off-manifold corners; separate in-box and out-of-box heldout observations
rules.violation: Exact real affine residual exceeding its per-output signed bound on an in-box row; out-of-box rows have no certificate premise
rules.native: Torch CPU float32 affine scores, separate observed float64 differences of native outputs; no kernel refinement theorem
rules.utility: Native queue target gain versus current parent at least 0.10 and protected local queue flip/net harm at most 0.01; certificate availability is separate
rules.inference: Descriptive Student-t intervals over six full-training-lineage means per domain; average repeated steps/orders/controllers inside lineage
rules.missingness: Every assigned record retained; missing target gain/net harm sensitivity [-1,1], usefulness [0,1]

release.canonical_sha256: Required external argument, never inferred from the gate itself
release.check_scope: Authenticate gate, preparation lock and terminal selection accounting without importing or auditing the live harness
